clue.text: After revolutionary massage I am an angel!

definitions.note: the answer is strictly a plural, the singular being cherub, though it is sometimes used as a singular

indicators.note: after says the massage piece follows the revolutionary in the answer

parts.note: Che Guevara is the stock revolutionary
to massage is to rub
I am contracts to I'm

explanation.surface: Someone emerges from a radical's massage feeling heavenly.
explanation.definitionFit: Cherubs are an order of angels in Christian tradition, the second rank of the heavenly hierarchy.

clue.text: Greek island occupied by sort of average entertainers

indicators.note: occupied by means the island word is filled with the average

parts.note: Cos (or Kos) is a Greek island
the median is one kind of average, the middle value

explanation.surface: A Greek island is overrun by middling performers.
explanation.definitionFit: Comedians are comic performers who entertain audiences.

clue.text: No longer enough to make a case

parts.note: ex means former, no longer
ample means plenty, enough

explanation.surface: Someone argues that what used to suffice no longer makes a case.
explanation.definitionFit: A case in point is an instance or specimen illustrating something.

clue.text: Refined old city bar, Edinburgh's No. 1

parts.note: Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city
to bar is to ban

indicators.note: No. 1 picks the first letter of Edinburgh

explanation.surface: The best bar in Edinburgh's old town is a polished place.
explanation.definitionFit: Urbane means suave and polished, courteous in manner.

clue.text: Country home completed starts to seem incredibly awful

parts.note: in means at home
done means completed

indicators.note: starts to picks the first letter of each of the next three words

explanation.surface: A finished country home seems incredibly awful.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a Southeast Asian nation made up of thousands of islands.

clue.text: Confidence booster is good — —? Do without

parts.note: the first blank is filled by the word that completes the saying: a confidence booster is good for something
the second blank is the self-esteem a confidence booster is good for

explanation.surface: A fill-in-the-blank saying about confidence boosters, then an instruction to go without.
explanation.walkthrough: The two dashes are blanks: complete 'Confidence booster is good for ego' and the missing two words, run together, give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To forgo (also spelt this way) is to abstain from or give up something.

clue.text: There's still time before work to get a haircut

indicators.note: before puts the time letter ahead of the work

parts.note: still, as in still water, is flat
op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: There's still time before work to nip out for a haircut.
explanation.definitionFit: A crew cut where the hair on top is cut short and level is called this.

clue.text: Legendary thief to do what he does wearing head covering

parts.note: what a thief does is rob
wearing something is being in it
a hood covers the head

explanation.surface: A legendary outlaw goes about his thieving with his hood up.
explanation.definitionFit: The outlaw of Sherwood Forest in English folklore stole from the rich to give to the poor.

clue.text: Material upset little fellow — something hairy

indicators.note: upset in a down clue turns the name upside down

parts.note: Reg, short for Reginald, is a fellow's name in shortened form
a mane is a growth of hair

explanation.surface: A small chap upset over some hairy fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Material in the sense of relevant or pertinent, as in material evidence.

clue.text: Bird no longer producing egg for mum to eat

indicators.note: for mum to eat means the egg letter goes inside the word for mother

parts.note: mum, mother, is MA
an egg is round like the letter O

explanation.surface: An extinct bird can no longer lay an egg for Mother's breakfast.
explanation.definitionFit: The giant flightless birds of New Zealand were hunted to extinction centuries ago.

clue.text: Be charmed, absurdly so, when bishop enters room for a rest

indicators.note: enters means the bishop's letter goes into the rearranged letters
absurdly says the letters of be charmed are put into a nonsensical new order

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: Someone is absurdly charmed when a bishop walks into the room where they are resting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'absurdly' rearranges BE CHARMED into, for example, ECHAMBER around D; 'enters' slips B in to make the ten letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedroom is the room where one sleeps or rests; this is its old-fashioned, grander name.

clue.text: Witness quiet individual overwhelmed by depression

indicators.note: overwhelmed by means the quiet individual is surrounded by the depression

parts.note: a dent is a depression in a surface
P, piano, is the musical abbreviation for quiet
an individual is one

explanation.surface: A shy witness feels crushed by depression.
explanation.definitionFit: In law a deponent is a person who gives sworn evidence, especially in a written statement.

clue.text: A knight joining secret society on an island

indicators.note: joining says the a and knight follow on from the secret society

parts.note: a tong is a Chinese secret society
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A knight is initiated into a clandestine order on some remote island.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes things belonging to Tonga, a Pacific island kingdom.

clue.text: A day to be bowled over by wonder

parts.note: Wed is the short form of Wednesday, a day

explanation.surface: A day spent utterly amazed by some marvel.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone overwhelmed by wonder is filled with awe, reverently impressed.

clue.text: Gun misbehaving? Get embarrassed, upset about it

indicators.note: about says the turned word wraps round the misbehaving word
upset turns the embarrassed word upside down in this down clue

parts.note: embarrassed people go red
erring means going astray, misbehaving

explanation.surface: Someone whose gun misfires turns red with embarrassment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns RED into DER, which then goes 'about' ERRING.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a small pocket pistol, named after its American maker Henry Deringer.

clue.text: Steamy spot abroad — such will never be reached

indicators.note: abroad, meaning astray or all over, says the letters of steamy spot are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A holidaymaker abroad seeks a steamy spot they never quite reach.
explanation.definitionFit: In maths these are lines a curve approaches ever closer but never actually meets.

clue.text: Procession with actor awkwardly getting in the way

indicators.note: getting in means the jumbled letters go inside the way word

parts.note: a mode is a way of doing something

indicators.note: awkwardly says the letters of actor are jumbled

explanation.surface: An actor clumsily obstructs a parade.
explanation.definitionFit: A motorcade is a procession of motor vehicles, typically escorting a dignitary.

clue.text: Somehow memorise litres to be carried? He may have to

indicators.note: somehow says the letters are combined in some new arrangement

explanation.surface: A wine waiter is told to memorise how many litres must be carried.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on the whole clue: a wine waiter may have to memorise wines and carry litres of them.
explanation.definitionFit: A wine waiter must know his cellar and carry bottles, so he may need to remember and fetch.

clue.text: Possibly Bath agent with skills for providing bits and pieces

parts.note: Bath, the English city of Roman baths, is an example of a spa, as Possibly signals
a rep, representative, is a sales agent
arts are skills, as in the arts of persuasion

explanation.surface: A skilled sales agent in Bath provides odds and ends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' marks Bath as only one example of a spa town; Bath is a Somerset city famous for its Roman baths.
explanation.definitionFit: Spare parts are replacement components, odd bits and pieces kept to fix things.

clue.text: Plant science's leading character featured in talk

indicators.note: featured in means that letter is placed within the talk word

parts.note: a parley is a discussion, talk

indicators.note: leading character picks the first letter of science

explanation.surface: Science's leading figure appears in a talk on plants.
explanation.definitionFit: Parsley is a culinary herb, a plant widely used as garnish.

clue.text: See past change here?

explanation.surface: Look at the old money in this place.

clue.text: Landlord finally gets drink container

parts.note: rum is a spirit, a drink

explanation.surface: A landlord at last brings the drink in a cask.

clue.text: Managed, with homage in short supply, to show enmity

indicators.note: in short supply means the homage word is cut short, losing its last letter

parts.note: to pay court is to pay homage

explanation.surface: Someone managed with little respect shown to them, breeding ill will.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancour is bitter, long-lasting resentment or hostility.

clue.text: Maybe fly as member of a religious group

parts.note: being a member of something is being in it
a sect is a religious group

explanation.surface: Perhaps someone takes off as a member of a religious group.
explanation.definitionFit: A fly is one example of a six-legged creature, as Maybe signals.

clue.text: Coaches — or their alternative?

definitions.meaning: to coach is to tutor or instruct someone
rather than travelling by coach, a bus, one may go by rail

explanation.surface: A traveller weighs taking the coaches or some other option.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means instructs; as a plural noun it means railway carriages, the alternative to buses.

clue.text: Big guns giving decree I ignored

indicators.note: ignored means the letter I is dropped from the decree word

parts.note: an ordinance is an authoritative decree

explanation.surface: Someone sees heavy weaponry deployed in defiance of a decree they ignored.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordnance is military artillery, mounted heavy guns collectively.

clue.text: Haggler tries endlessly to get this dock charge changed

indicators.note: changed says the remaining letters are rearranged
endlessly takes the last letter off each of the two words haggler and tries

explanation.surface: A haggler keeps trying to get a harbour fee altered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts both words, leaving HAGGLE and TRIE; 'changed' rearranges those ten letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A lighter is a barge; the fee for unloading cargo onto lighters at a port takes this name.

clue.text: The charm of a broad sash

a wide sash tied round a Japanese kimono

explanation.surface: A wide sash has a certain charm.

clue.text: Some fancy Prussian fabric

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A dandy from Prussia wears some fine cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Also spelt cypress, it is an old name for a thin crape or lawn fabric, often black for mourning.

clue.text: Repairer has hesitation about shop beginning to rot

indicators.note: about turns the hesitation word round

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitation
